arguments.command: grep -n "def get_node\|def replace_node\|class Document\|def save\|def __init__" .codex/skills/docx/scripts/document.py | head -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
with open('unpacked/word/document.xml') as f:
    xml = f.read()
# Find each paragraph with a w:u and print its text + underline presence
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p>.*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
for p in paras:
    if '<w:u w:val="single"/>' in p:
        texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
        print("UNDERLINED:", ''.join(texts).strip())
# Count total underlined paragraphs
print("Total underlined paragraphs:", sum(1 for p in paras if '<w:u w:val="single"/>' in p))
print("Total paragraphs:", len(paras))
EOF

python .codex/skills/docx/ooxml/scripts/pack.py unpacked quarterly_report.docx && python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re
with zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx') as z:
    xml = z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p>.*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
underlined = [''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)).strip() for p in paras if '<w:u w:val="single"/>' in p]
print("Packed OK. Underlined headlines in final file:", len(underlined))
for h in underlined:
    print(" -", h)
EOF
